text:
Tess: heads-up i'm about to merge a terraform tweak that swaps the serviceAccount annotation the rotation controller looks for. want a quick compatibility sanity check before i land it :eyes:

Omar: ping, what's the old -> new annotation mapping? any chance this will break projected-token refresh for long-lived pods?

Tess: old: `redwood.com/secret-rotation` -> new: `secrets.redwood.io/rotation-v2`
I put a short migration shim in the controller but i'd like infra to sign off on terraform bits + helm charts. merging in ~30m unless objections.

Liam: quick Q: does the shim prefer the new annotation or fall back? we should avoid double-annotating pods. also, can you paste the k8s snippet so i can grep our repos for usages?

Tess: shim logic = detect new annotation, else fall back to old; if both present it prefers new and logs a WARN. snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: example
  annotations:
    secrets.redwood.io/rotation-v2: "enabled"
spec:
  serviceAccountName: example-sa
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: alpine:3.18
```

Eva: quick grep i usually run: `rg "rotation-v2|secret-rotation" -S` across infra/ charts/ to find hardcoded bits. can you add a terraform migration comment to the tf var so it's obvious in diffs? also propose we add a 2-week soft-deprecation window in the controller logs before removing fallback.

Omar: one more: tf change touches `module/k8s_manifests/sa_annotations`. can you include a tf import plan if any existing SA resources need to be updated? otherwise we risk drift.

Tess: yep plan: (1) update module default map to include both keys for now, (2) rollout canary to staging clusters with controller v0.43 (has shim), (3) after 2 weeks flip module to emit only new key, (4) follow up with small PR to controller to remove fallback. i'll add tf import notes.

Liam: sounds good. can you post the PR link when it's up and tag infra-team? i'll run the grep + a quick ci smoke that touches projected-token refresh path.

Tess: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4827 (WIP) -- includes helm values and tf change. tagging @infra-team in the PR description.

vault-bot: automated note: rotation-controller v0.43 scheduled to be deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T04:00Z. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/rot-ctrl/1234 :robot_face:

Eva: perfect. one tiny nit — can we add a gauge to console showing number of pods still using old annotation? helps us measure migration progress.

Tess: good idea, adding an endpoint and grafana panel to the PR. thanks all! :tada:
